name: Stampezee
summary: Digital stamp cards for local businesses, replacing paper punch cards. Public pricing stays thin, so re-check the tiers before committing.
best_for: local businesses (cafés, salons, retail) that want a simple digital stamp-card loyalty program and can judge it inside a 14-day trial
skip_if: you need POS-integrated loyalty with CRM depth (bigger platforms exist), or your offer isn't repeat-visit shaped
honest_knock: The category is honest and proven (digital stamp cards beat lost paper cards), and the platform is young with limited public review coverage, so use the 14-day trial on a paid plan to run one real campaign and measure repeat-visit lift before the first charge, because the refund policy excludes changes of mind and unused plan periods. The deeper truth of loyalty programs: the mechanics are 10% of the outcome; a reward worth returning for is the other 90%.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Stamp Lite · per month for 1 branch and 1 active stamp card, with a 14-day free trial
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-13 on stampezee.com/en/pricing, the plan cards plus the plan data behind them; same plans and prices as on 2026-10-19) The free tier is no longer on the page. Three paid plans, each now with a 14-day free trial, plus a custom-priced Enterprise Plan. Stamp Lite $29.99/month: 1 branch, 1 active stamp card, unlimited customers and stamps, signup rewards, EzeeCodes and Give Stamps, birthday/anniversary/referral automations, no push notifications. Stamp Pro $49.99: 3 branches, 4 cards, spend-based stamping, tiered and exclusive rewards, lapsed-customer automation, 5 push notifications, a VIP card completion path. Stamp Elite $99.99: 10 branches, 12 cards, 10 push notifications including location-based ones, scratch-card campaigns, email marketing, a custom stamp card design, an exclusive marketing package and a dedicated account manager. Enterprise Plan: custom pricing based on locations, scale, usage and business requirements, with custom branch, card and usage limits and advanced roles and permission controls. The annual term (“Save 17%”) is in the plan data rather than on the cards: $299.99, $499.99 and $999.99 a year, ten months' money. StampEzee prices by region: the same data lists EUR 19.99, 39.99 and 69.99 and GBP 14.99, 29.99 and 59.99 a month. What changed since the 30 August 2026 reading: Stamp Start (free: 1 branch, 1 card, up to 100 customers or 100 stamps) no longer appears, Stamp Lite went from 2 branches and 3 cards to 1 and 1, Stamp Pro from 6 cards to 4, and the push allowances on Lite, Pro and Elite moved from 1, 4 and 8 to 0, 5 and 10. The monthly and annual prices did not change.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 18 November 2026 the session reached the account menu of Stampezee and stopped at the plan choice: the dashboard and Subscription Details sent the browser back to the pricing page, so the app is usable only after a plan is chosen. No plan was chosen and nothing was entered, so whether a card is asked was not seen and the product itself was not tested. The pricing page showed Stamp Lite EUR 19.99, Stamp Pro EUR 39.99 and Stamp Elite EUR 69.99 per month with 14 DAYS FREE TRIAL each and no free plan. Account and start: we created the account and our AI assistant looked at the app in our browser on the evening of 18 November 2026; the interface was in English (page stampezee.com/en/pricing). The dossier name is Stampezee and the review is on MSS (mss/stampezee-review.html); the app and the review are the same product. What the app showed: the account menu offers Dashboard, Subscription Details and Logout. The links lead to /en/retailer/dashboard and /en/retailer/billing-sub/payment-method-details. Both addresses, also when opened directly, sent the browser back to /en/pricing, so the dashboard can only be reached after a plan is chosen. Stop: no plan was chosen, nothing was entered and nothing was started. Whether a card is asked was not seen, because the step before it (the button Get Started) was not touched. The core function, building a stamp card, a test customer, a completed card and the time to a first completed card, was therefore not tested. Plans on the pricing page, read on 18 Nov 2026 (region Netherlands, euro): Stamp Lite EUR 19.99/month, Stamp Pro EUR 39.99/month (MOST POPULAR) and Stamp Elite EUR 69.99/month, each with 14 DAYS FREE TRIAL; an Enterprise Plan with Custom Pricing (Contact Sales). Every plan has the button Get Started. A switch reads Monthly / Save 17% Annually. There is no free plan. Limits per plan from the comparison table (Lite, Pro, Elite): active stamp cards 1, 4 and 12; branches 1, 3 and 10; push notifications per month 0, 5 and 10; unlimited customers and stamps on all three. These match the dossier (price field of 13 Nov), which names the same plans, limits and regional euro prices and no free plan; no deviation. Prices were not changed by this delivery. Screenshots: none were kept, because the header of every page showed our name and avatar; there is no image to check or mask. Cancelling: not applicable, because no plan or trial was started. Not tested: everything after the plan choice, which means the card step, the dashboard, building a stamp card, a test customer, the trial itself, checkout, tax and cancelling. Clean up: no plan, no trial and no test data; nothing was entered, sent or bought; the own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The dashboard and Subscription Details cannot be opened before a plan is chosen, also not by address, so you cannot look around the app before you pick one of the paid plans. There is no free plan.
